messages.subject: Errors and issues
parts:
I am trying to map a population that is many markers and individuals and i am having a few difficulties to say the least, my R skills are quite rusty and i am using code written by a colleague and some of what i had ran a while back using Karl Bowman's text.

The marker data does not converge ( i hope I am phrasing this correctly). Secondly the individual chromosomes and overall map are highly improbable based on previous knowledge of the soybean molecular map (read= the map is huge)
please see the following example of code and abbreviated results:
Any help will be appreciated.

> setwd("c:/R files")
> library(qtl)
> DATAQTL1=read.cross("csvsr",genfile="DATAgeno302.csv", phefile="DATACystein.csv",na.strings=c("-"), genotypes=c("A","H","B"), estimate.map=FALSE)
--Read the following data:
302 individuals
17236 markers
3 phenotypes
--Cross type: f2
Warning message:
In summary.cross(cross) :
Some chromosomes > 1000 cM in length; there may be a problem with the genetic map.
(Perhaps it is in basepairs?)
> DATAQTL1=convert2riself(DATAQTL1)
Warning message:
In convert2riself(DATAQTL1) : Omitting 404078 genotypes with code==2.
> ## look for markers with identical DATAQTL1
> dupmark=findDupMarkers(DATAQTL1)
>
> ## drop duplicate markers
> DATAQTL1=drop.markers(DATAQTL1, unlist(dupmark))

## table of genotypes
> gt=geno.table(DATAQTL1, scanone.output=TRUE)
> plot(gt, bandcol="gray70") # plot -log10 P-values
## chromosome 2
> ######################################################################
> # estimate recombination fractions just for chromosome 2
> rf=pull.rf(est.rf(subset(DATAQTL1, chr=2)))
> ## plot recombination fractions for adjacent markers
> plot(rf[row(rf) == col(rf)+1], xlab="left marker index", ylab="Recombination fraction")
>
> which(rf[row(rf)==col(rf)+1] > 0.3)
[1] 190 191 258 262
> nlinked <- apply(rf, 2, function(a) sum(a < 0.4, na.rm=TRUE))
> plot(nlinked)
> badmar2 <- names(nlinked[nlinked < 100])
>
> ## delete the unlinked markers
> for(marker in badmar2)
+ DATAQTL1=drop.markers(DATAQTL1, marker)
> ## estimate map for chromosome 2
> nm2=est.map(DATAQTL1, chr=2, error.prob=0, maxit=10, verbose=2)
Chr 2:
1 max rel've change = 1.5635280
2 max rel've change = 0.9342084
3 max rel've change = 0.8816494
4 max rel've change = 0.7316003
5 max rel've change = 0.5276951
6 max rel've change = 0.4225471
7 max rel've change = 0.3220611
8 max rel've change = 0.2610824
9 max rel've change = 0.1940818
10 max rel've change = 0.1322405
loglik: -3118.8793

Warning message:
Didn't converge!
>
> ## replace chr 2 map
> DATAQTL1=replace.map(DATAQTL1, nm2)
> plot.map(DATAQTL1, chr=1:2)

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Errors and issues
parts:
The "didn't converge" warning message regards the estimation of inter-marker distances, which uses an iterative algorithm.

You want to look for markers that are badly behaved or misplaced. Take a look at the tutorial on genetic map construction: http://www.rqtl.org/tutorials/geneticmaps.pdf

karl
